definitions.explanation: The thin membrane inside the ear that vibrates in response to sound waves, enabling hearing.

examples.japanese: {鼓膜|こまく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{破|やぶ}れた→破れる：02322_yabureru⟧。
⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{鼓膜|こまく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{傷|きず}つける→傷つける：01935_kizutsukeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Loud sounds can damage the eardrum.

examples.english: I went to the hospital because deep inside my ear hurt, and I was told there was inflammation of the eardrum.

notes:
A compound of {鼓|こ} (drum) and {膜|まく} (membrane). The name reflects the drum-like shape and vibrating function of this thin tissue. The eardrum is a common topic in everyday health conversations, especially regarding ear infections ({中耳炎|ちゅうじえん}), pressure changes during flights, and noise exposure.

- {鼓膜|こまく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{破|やぶ}れる→破れる：02322_yabureru⟧: the eardrum ruptures

- {鼓膜|こまく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{穴|あな}→穴：01691_ana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|あ}く→開く：00689_aku⟧: a hole opens in the eardrum
- {鼓膜|こまく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{再生|さいせい}→再生：04442_saisei⟧: eardrum regeneration

SIMILAR WORDS:
